environment.description: Quarkus 2.16 Lambda handler deployed in AWS Lambda with VPC configuration. S3 access via gateway VPC endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e) with default full-access policy. Lambda execution role has s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::acme-reports-prod/*. No request validation layer. API Gateway passthrough integration with no request models or validators configured.

config.api_gateway: REST API with no request validation
